params.name: cert_expiry_duration
params.description: Filter by certificate expiry within a specific duration from now (e.g., "7d" for 7 days, "1m" for 1 month)

params.name: edr_managed
params.description: Filters NAC clients that are integrated with EDR providers

params.name: edr_provider
params.description: EDR provider of client's organization

params.name: edr_status
params.description: EDR Status of the NAC client

params.name: family
params.description: Partial / full Client family (e.g. "Phone/Tablet/Wearable", "Access Point"). Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `Surveillance*` and `*urveillance*` match `Surveillance Camera`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*Camera`) are not supported

params.name: hostname
params.description: Partial / full Client hostname. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*everest`) are not supported

params.name: idp_id
params.description: SSO ID, if present and used

params.name: mac
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC Address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*bccddeeff`) are not supported

params.name: mdm_compliance
params.description: MDM compliance of client i.e "compliant", "not compliant"

params.name: mdm_provider
params.description: MDM provider of client’s organization eg "intune", "jamf"

params.name: mdm_managed
params.description: Filters NAC clients that are managed by MDM providers

params.name: mfg
params.description: Partial / full Client manufacturer (e.g. "apple", "cisco", "juniper"). Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `Raspberry Pi*` and `*Pi*` match `Raspberry Pi Trading Ltd`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*Ltd`) are not supported

params.name: model
params.description: Client model, e.g. "iPhone 12", "MX100"

params.name: nacrule_name
params.description: NAC Policy Rule Name matched

params.description: NAC Policy Rule ID, if matched

params.name: os
params.description: Client OS, e.g. "iOS 18.1", "Android", "Windows", "Linux"

params.description: SSID
